rationale.conceptual: The method uses a modified Universal Force Field with custom parameters, charge equilibration, and Ewald summation for a periodic 3D framework. Reproducing the activation energy requires understanding of molecular mechanics, constraining specific atoms during transition-state optimization, and handling the Li(1)-Li(2) pathway. It is an established but non-trivial technique with several interacting components, yet the paper gives explicit parameters and a step-by-step recipe.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of 3-4 sequential steps: obtaining a CIF, building the unit cell, setting up the force field and minimizations, and computing energies. All operations can be performed with a single standard molecular simulation package (e.g., LAMMPS). No heavy data acquisition, complex orchestration, or fragile handoffs; the I/O is a simple JSON file.
